CIVIC DATA SYSTEMS 2026 Proxy Statement
The Annual Meeting of Shareholders will be held on September 10, 2026.
The record date for voting is July 22, 2026.
Proposal 1: Election of directors. Board recommendation: FOR.
Shareholder Proposal 5: Report on litigation and regulatory compliance risks related to federal investigations. Board recommendation: AGAINST.
The supporting statement asks the board to assess potential costs from pending inquiries.
